question: List all the card id and artist with unknown power which are legal for commander play format.
final_sql: SELECT c.id, c.artist FROM cards AS c JOIN legalities AS l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE (c.power = '*' OR c.power IS NULL) AND l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'Legal'

question: Which of the play format has the highest number of banned status? Indicate the play format and the names of all the card meet the condition.
final_sql: WITH top_format AS ( SELECT format FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned' GROUP BY format ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, format LIMIT 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT l.format, c.name FROM legalities AS l JOIN cards AS c ON l.uuid = c.uuid JOIN top_format AS t ON l.format = t.format WHERE l.status = 'Banned' ORDER BY c.name;

question: Find and list the names of cards which doesn't have Japanese translation but have Korean translation.
final_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM cards AS c INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT uuid FROM foreign_data WHERE language = 'Korean') AS k ON c.uuid = k.uuid LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT uuid FROM foreign_data WHERE language LIKE '%Japanese%') AS j ON c.uuid = j.uuid WHERE j.uuid IS NULL ORDER BY c.name
